decision.reason: Primary source validates the application class and double buffering, but there is no inspected application kernel/compute/slot-release trace or failure of matched ordinary controls on this platform. Missing evidence cannot reject B. Different cycles-per-byte sweep points cannot be joined into a claimed runtime phase sequence.
decision.if_a_is_ready: Only A enters the model in this round; do not build B to maintain concurrency.
decision.if_neither_is_ready: Record the minimum evidence missing for each workflow; do not invent a dynamic workload.

primary_source.title: Scalable and Efficient Virtual Memory Sharing in Heterogeneous SoCs with TLB Prefetching and MMU-Aware DMA Engine

evidence.claim: Regularly strided blocks, host single input/output buffer, configurable block computation, separate double-buffered input and output in L1 SPM.
Compute cycles per data are changed across configurations. This does not establish runtime phase transitions.
Compiler helper prefetch uses actual WT execution state and bounded lead windows, including interference delays; broad program-progress-directed translation setup is prior art.
256 KiB L1 SPM, up to eight AXI bursts, software-managed hybrid IOMMU and 32/256 TLB entries differ from this platform.
Overall optimum configuration and compile/runtime selection are discussed without a measured SP runtime phase/control trace.
program_single, NEXT_ID and DONE provide one-copy software supply, not a compute/slot-release state machine.
Static Sv39 S1 4 KiB leaves, S2 zero, V fixed COPY pages and A page ring. No application SPM mapping is specified.
Batch requires 4096-byte DEFAULT aligned copies and counts actual ready/done.
COUNT commits stable VALID; WAIT waits true completion; GAP is post-copy countdown; ADMIT controls only the next unpublished copy.
Current A gate enable=0/allow=1 and controlled launch hold/go=0.
Map helper uses IOMMU_READ|IOMMU_WRITE; current stream_prepare calls it using PAGE_SIZE.
Stream buffers request physical contiguity and are separately mapped page by page; huge-page exclusion needs an actual application constraint.
Existing controller uses V done-byte feedback for budget and mode6 gap; it is not wholly static and does not yet supply application compute/slot events.
Production policy/launch connectivity is profile-dependent; larger/multijob streams lie outside the current private-buffer dependency argument.
Prior negative result is fixed COPY with CPU off in modeled DDR; it does not reject stream-processing workflows.

assumptions: independent block footprints or explicit cross-block/halo dependencies
input and output each have two slots
dependency_template.input_issue_requirement: Previous block j-2 no longer reads the selected input slot; conservative release is compute_done(j-2).
dependency_template.input_reuse_requirement: All compute reads from the old input slot are complete.
dependency_template.output_reuse_requirement: Actual DMA drain completion, including applicable write response.
dependency_template.host_in_place_requirement: Writeback cannot destroy data required by future overlapping/halo blocks.
dependency_template.minimum_application_storage: 2 input blocks + 2 output blocks; if equal-sized, 4*block_bytes, plus metadata/synchronization
dependency_template.dma_parallelism: Single V DMA interleaving input/output is distinct from two V DMAs; both must count actual resource budgets.

failure_hypothesis.statement: For one fixed, legal double-buffered application, A shared translation service delay consumes finite input/output overlap slack and causes avoidable compute input/output-slot stalls despite adequate average capacity/bandwidth; matched static controls or existing window feedback may fail to cover those stalls.
failure_hypothesis.competitor: H_B0: huge pages, advance preparation, ordinary service priority, static quota or existing feedback already meet the application objective, or stalls arise from supply/data/compute/aliasing rather than translation.
failure_hypothesis.new_information: unselected; existing program ready/compute_done/slot-free must be a strong simple information-matched comparison
failure_hypothesis.new_action: unselected; no new gate is authorized by this prefilter
failure_hypothesis.decisive_observation: A specific compute bubble has an actual input/output DMA predecessor waiting on shared translation, and a bounded existing-service intervention removes that bubble under identical workload and full A completion.
adjacent_counterexamples: measured compute slack covers the observed translation delay
legal large-page or retained-entry mapping removes the relevant miss
falsifiers: ordinary matched control covers all registered loss
bubble persists after removing the identified translation wait
a concrete trace contradicts the claimed buffer/alias contract
admission_blockers: no feasible costed application-to-platform adaptation boundary

baselines.fairness: Do not label as static; register windows/targets/initial state and include adaptation.

baselines.fairness: No free future events; account reporting latency, slot generation, routing and existing in-flight debt. If sufficient, do not claim a duplicate rule as novel.

minimum_missing_evidence: One real kernel and one fixed parameter point with dimensions, block/stride, halo/alias, in-place/output ownership and compute resource.
A reconstructable block/slot-generation trace: input issue/done, compute start/done/last read, output issue/done/free; include pipeline fill/drain.
A feasible port/storage/compute/coherence/supply adaptation plan with one-vs-two V DMA budget and costs.
A specific ordinary-control failure hypothesis and a bounded registered question; lack of measured support does not bar G0, but support is required before G1.
